probe.question: EDC coupling in DCM gave me 34%, but our own solvent screen said a chlorinated solvent should sit around 70. What did we get wrong?
forbids_claims: a note id that was not retrieved
that DCM is simply a bad solvent for this coupling
a cause the failure-mode note does not record
probe.direction: Retrieves failure-dcm-amide-coupling and gives the recorded cause: the run was held at 20 °C throughout instead of starting at 0 °C, so the O-acylisourea rearranges to the N-acylurea before the amine reaches it. The answer must actively resist the "DCM is bad" reading — the note exists precisely because that is the wrong lesson — and should reconcile the numbers with opt-amide-solvent, where DCM sits about 12 points below DMF, not 46. Cites note ids.
